response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad engineering experience, current Staff-level title, and genuinely relevant recent work on AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks), which maps well to the AI-native mindset the role treats as baseline. He has credible high-throughput distributed systems exposure at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby (microservices handling millions of requests per second, async I/O, fibers, caching) and strong craftsmanship signals via TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, open-source tooling, and teaching. The main gap is Python: it is a must-have and appears nowhere in his skills list or job history, with his depth concentrated in TypeScript/Node and DLang. Evidence of staff-level technical strategy, cross-functional stakeholder management, and formal on-call/incident ownership is also thin — most descriptions are individual delivery-focused. Worth a screen to probe Python depth and scope of influence, but not a clear yes on paper.
strengths: Hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling experience matching AI-native environment
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work at Sociomantic
Strong TypeScript/Node depth plus deep testing and craftsmanship culture
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience despite it being a must-have
Limited evidence of technical strategy or stakeholder management at scale
No explicit on-call, incident response, or agile ceremony ownership signals
